name: Auto service centres

seo.title: Google Reviews for Auto Service Centers | SAAYT
seo.description: Track and answer Google reviews for every service center in the customer’s dialect and update hours and services across branches at once

h1: Every service centre with the same reputation
lead: Car owners read reviews before handing over their keys. SAAYT lets you answer every review in every centre and update hours and services in one go

pains.d: A review about price or a late handover affects every branch not just one
Some centres work late and some close on Fridays and customers need to know
Customers write about a specific part or service and need a clear answer

helps.d: Clear replies in the customer’s dialect approved by the centre manager
Hours and season hours for every centre from one template
Services and numbers right in every branch

example.review: Clean work but they said the car would be ready at noon and I got it at sunset
example.reply: Thank you for trusting us. We apologise for the late handover and have raised it with the centre manager to tighten delivery times. We hope to serve you better on your next visit
example.note: A clear apology without long excuses

faq.q: Does it support centres in different cities?
faq.a: Yes. Filter centres by city and apply changes to one city only

faq.q: Can each centre manager reply for their centre?
faq.a: Yes. Permissions are per branch and operations sees everything
